title: calendar signal
description: Calendar events read by the host app via EventKit (CalendarProvider.swift): from the start of today to 8 days later, sorted by start, rewritten every 5 min and on every calendar-database change. Without the host app the server serves providers.calendar.file instead. GET /api/signals/calendar, polled every 30 s. Never 404; {"events": []} when there is no data. SENSITIVE (titles, locations).

end.description: End, ISO 8601 UTC. For all-day events this is the last second of the day in local time.

calendar.description: Name of the calendar the event belongs to.

status.description: Availability: 'free' or 'busy' (EventKit availability; anything but free is busy).

ts.description: When the host app wrote the file. Unix time in seconds (float). Absent in the empty fallback.
